description: This file defines a React functional component ClientsList, which displays a list of clients fetched from an API. It includes logic for loading data, handling errors, and deleting clients, with UI elements for navigation and actions.

methods.name: ClientsList()
methods.description: React functional component that displays a list of clients with options to add, edit, or delete clients.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the list of clients from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a client by ID, prompts for confirmation, calls API to delete, handles errors, and reloads data upon success.
